_comment: Golden roll-ups for the eval spine. Score = V x R x U per the agent doc: V High=3/Medium=2/Low=1; R READY=1.0/PARALLEL-OK=0.7/NEEDS-GROOMING=0.4/BLOCKED=0.1; U = 1 + 0.2 per not-done in-scope item this story blocks. Score tolerance +-0.05. PROJ-501..508 = the state matrix; PROJ-510..515 = adversarial traps, each named in its why.
